plural of inquiline

   other insects.

a. 寄居动物的

inquire.definition:
v inquire about
v have a wish or desire to know something
v conduct an inquiry or investigation of
inquire.translation: v. 询问, 问明, 查究

inquired.translation: v. 打听, 询问( inquire的过去式和过去分词 )

inquirer.definition: n. someone who asks a question
inquirer.translation:
n. 询问者, 探究者, 调查者

n a systematic investigation of a matter of public interest

n. 质询, 探索, 调查, 询盘

inquisition.definition:
n. a former tribunal of the Roman Catholic Church (1232-1820) created to discover and suppress heresy
n. a severe interrogation (often violating the rights or privacy of individuals)
inquisition.translation:
n. 调查, 探究, 审理, 宗教裁判所
[医] 调查, 审查

inquisitional.definition:
a. Relating to inquiry or inquisition; inquisitorial;
   also, of or pertaining to, or characteristic of, the Inquisition.
inquisitional.translation: a. 调查的, 宗教裁判所的

inquisitions.definition:
n. a former tribunal of the Roman Catholic Church (1232-1820) created to discover and suppress heresy
n. a severe interrogation (often violating the rights or privacy of individuals)
inquisitions.translation: n. <正>调查, 审讯( inquisition的复数形式 )

inquisitive.definition:
s. showing curiosity
s. inquiring or appearing to inquire

inquisitorial.definition:
a. especially indicating a form of prosecution in which proceedings are secret and the accused is questioned by a prosecutor who acts also as the judge
s. marked by inquisitive interest; especially suggestive of an ecclesiastical inquisitor
s. having the authority to conduct official investigations

a. 询问者的, 严格审问的, 好询问的

inquisitors.definition:
n. a questioner who is excessively harsh

inquorate.translation: a. 不构成法定人数的
